Settings

Effective settings

Highest first: flags, then ICHAVA_* environment, then the global config, then a pack's own settings, then defaults. This is config print --origins for the run as a whole; a pack's page shows its own layer merged in.

Every setting, its value and where it came from
SettingValueFrom
config_dir
directory holding packs.json and the pack configs (default: config/ beside the binary, else ./config when it holds packs.json, else the config/ of the repository around the working directory, up to 5 levels)
 – default
private_config_dir
directory of private pack configs merged over config_dir at run time (packs.json optional; none by default)
 – default
log_level
log verbosity; -v is debug, -q is error
 info default
concurrency
packs synced at once by sync --all / sync-all
 2 env
allowed_hosts
extra upstream hosts, comma separated, on top of the built-in github.com, api.github.com, codeload.github.com, registry.npmjs.org and unicode.org (https only)
 – default
workspace
directory holding the pack checkouts: a relative pack_root is resolved against it, and it replaces the /work/<pack> a shipped config names (default: /work if present, else the checkouts beside this repository)
 – default
dry_run
fetch and diff, but write nothing into the pack and skip the version stamp, commit, push and pull request
 false default
force
refresh even when the pack is not behind upstream
 false default
git.author
author and committer of sync commits, as `Name <email>`
 ichava-sync-bot <41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com> default
git.base
base branch the pull request targets
 develop global
git.branch
sync branch; {version} is the upstream version
 chore/sync-upstream-{version} default
git.commit_subject
commit and PR title; {pack}, {old}, {new} are interpolated
 chore(upstream): bump {pack} to v{new} default
git.commit_body
commit and PR body; same tokens as the subject
 Automated sync from upstream {pack} {old} -> {new}. Generated by ichava/icon-sets-sync. See docs/maintainer-sync.md in that repository. default
git.open_pr
open a pull request after pushing
 true default
emoji.unicode_version
Unicode emoji release whose emoji-test.txt drives categorisation; must exist at unicode.org/Public/emoji/
 16.0 default
